verdict.rationale: Lago documents dunning-adjacent capabilities: a 'cash-collection' feature to spot overdue/unpaid invoices via filters (lago-docs-13) and a 'Dunning Agent' that reads invoices, payments, disputes, and provider status (lago-docs-10). However, there is no evidence of configurable branded emails, in-app banners, grace periods, or explicit cancel-vs-unpaid final-state rules. Missing for 10: branded email templates, in-app banner UI, grace period configuration, explicit final-state (cancel/unpaid) rule settings, and independent confirmation of the dunning workflow in practice.
